acceptanceCriteria.text: Below the VIRTUAL puml collection, a TREE of physical-folder scenario-units renders showing the REAL on-disk folder paths where the .puml files live. @390 screenshot: under 'puml (61)', the physical folder tree is visible.

A puml name appearing in multiple folders (measured: class-diagram.puml x4) renders under EACH real physical folder, so the user sees WHICH folder each lives in — the duplicate names are EXPLAINED by the physical tree. Screenshot: the 4 class-diagram.puml appear under 4 distinct folder paths, not as 4 identical siblings.
The physical folders are REAL Folder scenario-units (rides R40.16, NO duplicate folder model — reuse the folder-as-unit type).
The virtual puml collection is KEPT (not replaced): virtual collection above, physical-folder tree below. Screenshot: both are present.
[DEVICE @390 - Tron] Tron verifies on his phone that the physical folder tree renders beneath the virtual puml collection with the real paths.
stub-must-fail: a puml name that lives in multiple physical folders but renders under only ONE (or none) => RED (the physical tree must reveal all real locations).
